previewText: Barrow County market notes, an August porch reset, a Lawrenceville family outing, and a simple peach-tomato recipe.

paragraphs: This is the point in August when the school-year rhythm starts to feel real. The first few mornings are behind us, but the evenings are still full of backpacks, practices, late-summer rain, and all the small things that make a house work harder than usual.

If your home has one little annoyance you have been stepping around, this is a good week to knock it out before September gets here. What is the small fix at your house that would make the biggest difference?

market.title: Barrow County market snapshot for July 2026
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: Realtor.com reported 607 active listings in Barrow County during July 2026, 25.3% higher from one year earlier.
The median listing price was $392,233. Median days on market came in at 59 days, 22.9% higher year over year.
For homeowners, the useful takeaway is that local conditions matter. Price, preparation, and neighborhood-level competition still shape the result for any individual home.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data for July 2026.

homeownerTip.title: Quiet the sticky-door season before fall.
homeownerTip.intro: Late-August humidity and quick showers can make doors, hinges, and latches act up. Pick one entry door and give it a quick reset:
items: Add a small amount of lubricant to the latch and hinges
Check whether the door rubs after rain or only at certain times of day
homeownerTip.closing: A quieter, smoother entry makes busy mornings and grocery runs a little easier.

localEvent.title: Midsummer JR. at Aurora Theatre
localEvent.intro: For a close-to-home family outing, downtown Lawrenceville has a short children's theater option this weekend.
localEvent.copy: The Downtown Lawrenceville calendar lists Midsummer JR. at Aurora Theatre on Saturday, August 22, from 11:30 AM to 12:15 PM. The listing describes it as a reimagined Shakespeare comedy for young audiences, with fairies, flowers, and funny mix-ups.
localEvent.tip: Tip: Check the calendar or Aurora Theatre before heading out for tickets, timing, and any schedule updates.

cartoon.imageAlt: A cheerful late-August front porch scene with a homeowner quieting a squeaky door while carrying groceries and a school backpack
cartoon.caption: "The door only squeaks when everyone is carrying something."
cartoon.closing: A five-minute fix has excellent timing.

realEstateQuestion.question: If days on market are up, should I wait to sell?
answer: Not automatically. Longer market times usually mean buyers are comparing more carefully, so the launch plan matters more. Pricing, prep, photos, and the first two weeks of feedback can tell you more than the countywide average alone.

rotatingFeature.title: Simple Georgia peach and tomato salad
paragraphs: A quick seasonal idea: combine sliced tomatoes, peaches, a little basil, olive oil, and a pinch of salt. Keep it simple and serve chilled or at room temperature.
